canonical_statement: For every Borel subset A of Baire space Nat -> Nat, the length-omega Gale-Stewart game in which Player I moves at even stages and wins exactly when the play belongs to A is determined.
domain_and_universes: Play = Nat -> Nat; History = List Nat; Strategy = History -> Nat; all definitions are in Prop/Type 0.
conclusion: A Player-I strategy forces every compatible play into payoff, or a Player-II strategy forces every compatible play outside payoff.
minimal_import_check: Removing the sole import makes the module fail elaboration.
